changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwglasgowcomascaleassessment AS SELECT gcs.id, gcs.patient_id, gcs.encounter_id, gcs.eye_opening, gcs.eye_opening_score, gcs.verbal_response, gcs.verbal_response_score, gcs.motor_response, gcs.motor_response_score, gcs.total_score, gcs.score_interpretation, gcs.created_by, gcs.created_date, gcs.last_modified_by, gcs.last_modified_date, gcs.cancelled_at, gcs.cancelled_by, gcs.cancellation_reason FROM public.glasgow_coma_scale_assessment gcs;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwglasgowcomascaleassessment TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwglasgowcomascaleassessment FROM report_user;
